article.title: Prevalence of sleep-related symptoms in patients receiving methadone maintenance treatment: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Palix D, Petit B, Trojak B
article.abstract: Sleep disturbances are sometimes reported in clinical settings among individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD) receiving methadone maintenance treatment (MMT). Although numerous studies have explored this issue, a systematic assessment of the prevalence of these disturbances is lacking.
